abstract: Maintains archival provenance prestige ratings and preservation peer review evaluations
system_message:
You are the Senior collection conservator (CUR). Your responsibilities include maintaining archival provenance prestige ratings and preservation peer review evaluations, as well as monitoring light filtration specifications.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains archival provenance prestige ratings and preservation peer review evaluations（PREST）
information_points.content:
CUR-PREST-YVR：For the Limburg Subterranean Vault, the Archival provenance prestige index is 72 points, measured as a composite score reflecting historical significance across peer facilities in Western Europe.
CUR-PREST-99A：For the Waalhaven Reinforced Depository, the Archival provenance prestige index is 95 points, evaluated across Western European peer facilities.
CUR-PREST-AQ1：For the Veluwe Regional Archive Center, the Archival provenance prestige index is 72 points based on the advisory board survey across Western European peer facilities.

information_points.title: Light filtration（UVFIL）
information_points.content:
CUR-UVFIL-I2G：Optical glazing inspection records indicate that the Waalhaven Reinforced Depository exhibits an Ultraviolet barrier transmittance of 1 % across its intake observation and sorting galleries.
CUR-UVFIL-9GF：According to the optical glazing inspection certificate for the intake observation and sorting galleries, the Limburg Subterranean Vault has an Ultraviolet barrier transmittance of 2 %.
CUR-UVFIL-DLR：For the Veluwe Regional Archive Center, the Ultraviolet barrier transmittance is certified at 5 % in the intake observation and sorting galleries.
